803-2034-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-2034-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

6249-7256-8095--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy kicked by paying {2}{B}{R}, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy's delayed ability trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-6578-6798.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-6578-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4506-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4506-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1558-3756-3875-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3756-3875-4231-7824.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2946-3220-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3220-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

6798-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
6798-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7728.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Voracious Brood enters, Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-5686-7646.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

650-3175-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

423-1257-1437-5233--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1257-1437-5233--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1295-3755-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

1849-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2292-2366-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2292-2366-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1379-1978-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat

339-413-677-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3197-4017-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-6752.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-3086-3175.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities.

880-4871-6517.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-6517.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

955-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
955-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

2523-4050-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
2523-4050-5562.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath, adding one mana of any color.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

1792-3139-5864.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1792-3139-5864.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Retraction Helix.
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3487-4374-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You have at least two energy counters.
3487-4374-5921.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

290-2619-4483.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
290-2619-4483.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Rod of Absorption.
Echo Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Dreamstone Hedron.
Resolve all copies of Echo Storm, creating that many token copies of Dreamstone Hedron.
Resolve the original Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Rod of Absorption and exiling Echo Storm due to Rod of Absorption.
Activate two Dreamstone Hedron tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Activate the original Rod of Absorption by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to cast Echo Storm from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the Rod of Absorption token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact you control using Echo Storm, or sacrifice the Dreamstone Hedron tokens to draw infinite cards.

1395-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1395-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2440-2609-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Soldiers.
2440-2609-4050.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more other Soldiers, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.

549-3698-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference, triggering Grinding Station, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

258-575-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature.
You control at least six lands.
258-575-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken creature.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
The face-down Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Tatyova, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental with haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1621-1987-4344.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Lumbering Battlement and any land you control.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield.
Wispweaver Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.
